english.title: Employer fail to notify authority of material change in Schedule 1 particulars affecting licensable work with asbestos
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employer, failed in respect of licensable work with asbestos, to notify the appropriate enforcing authority, namely **(..NAME THE AUTHORITY..), of a material change, which might have affected the particulars notified in accordance with regulation 9(1)(a) of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012, in writing and without delay
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 9(1)(b) of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 and section 33(1)(c) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: These Regulations apply to any work outside Great Britain to which sections 1 to 59 and 80 to 82 of the Health and Safety at Work Act etc 1974 Act apply by virtue of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 (Application Outside Great Britain) Order 2001 as they apply to work in Great Britain.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Note: In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (general limit on magistrates' court's powers to imprison), a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months is to be read as a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months.
